name: @chbrain/khai-engine-commute
description: khai engine content, the commute domain: a cost agreed once and incurred every morning -- the trade struck on unequal information, the passage that costs most on its ordinary days, the settling that erases one side of the bargain, and the ledger that cannot be audited from inside.
license: SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE and LICENSE-CODE

khai.tagline: Commute as process: a cost agreed once and incurred every morning, read on what the trade did afterwards rather than on whether it was sensible -- not the return of feeling to a baseline after a change, which is hedonic-adaptation's, and not the wait imposed by an institution, which is waiting's -- across four movements: the trade (an extra room that keeps its value and loses its voice, minutes priced at the journey's best day, and one calculation made in advance and never checked against the outcome), the passage (variance that charges every day for the worst one, no control that keeps the effort and removes the option, and a hollow hour that is worth having and not worth what it costs), the settling (a house absorbed entirely intact and no longer counting for anything, a drive unabsorbed because of what its edge is made of, and a widening gap that is a deterioration made entirely of adaptation), and the ledger (an invisible gain that is a good argument with nothing behind it, an unattributed cost paid in a currency it is not recorded in, and a next move decided by somebody who has learned nothing they can use) -- with the twist that everything the commute was traded for stops being felt, and the commute does not.

card.wire: Attaches at Persona. The anchor (process_commute.md) declares the arrangement: a gap between home and work accepted once and crossed twice a day. It is not hedonic-adaptation's return of feeling to a baseline, not waiting's imposed delay, and not stress's load on the body. Read it on what the trade did afterwards, never on whether it was sensible.
card.issue: Four movements over one root. The trade compares something inspected with something estimated: months are spent on the house and the journey is a number on a map, produced for its best day. The passage costs most on the days it goes as expected, because unpredictability is paid for in the buffer built into every departure rather than in the delay itself. The settling erases one side of the bargain: the extra room is absorbed within a season, and the variance and the powerlessness are the conditions adaptation handles worst, so the same arrangement is worth less every year with nothing having changed. The ledger is why nobody can audit it from inside.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the engine. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the anchor, so the commute read runs wherever the play has somebody travel to work. The link: each persona links, under Projection, where they stand to it -- what the distance bought, how long the journey is on a bad day, what they do with the time, and what they blame the evening on.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; the read is judged. The kit verifies the law is declared and each persona links a real member. Whether a production's persona is defending the journey or enduring it, and whether a difficult evening came from the office or the road, are judgements the team makes; the suite does not attempt them.
card.setup: Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the anchor. Then make the trade sensible and the house genuinely good, because the engine needs no bad decision and stops working the moment it gets one. Keep the journey ordinary and mostly fine. And read the twist before writing any scene at the kitchen table -- the persona is about to be short with somebody, the reason is available to nobody in the room, and the arrangement that produced it was agreed by everybody present.
